headline: OpenAI releases GPT 5.6 Sol with major vision capabilities upgrade
body: OpenAI has released GPT 5.6 Sol, positioned as its most advanced vision model to date. For healthcare AI applications, improved vision capabilities directly impact clinical workflows that depend on medical imaging analysis, pathology slide review, and radiological interpretation. This advancement matters for EHR integration and diagnostic support tools where visual data processing accuracy directly influences clinical decision-making. Healthcare organizations and vendors evaluating foundation models for imaging applications should assess how this release affects their roadmaps for AI-assisted diagnosis and documentation automation.
